## TemplateEngine.compileBlockGPrecheckoutError() method

Compiles precheckout-error blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileBlockGPrecheckoutError(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processGBaseBlocks>): {
        [AGBaseId: string]: {
            [ALang: string]: (data?: ITemplateData) => string;
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[AGBaseId: string\]: { \[ALang: string\]: (data?: ITemplateData) =&gt; string; }; }

Compiled precheckout-error functions organized by base ID and language

## Remarks

This method parses `<g-precheckout-error>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate rendered decline messages. Same organization and pipeline as `compileBlockGCallbackAnswer`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const compiled = TemplateEngine.compileBlockGPrecheckoutError(`<g-base><g-precheckout-error>Stok {{item}} habis</g-precheckout-error></g-base>`);
const text = compiled.default?.default?.({item: `kopi`});
// Result: 'Stok kopi habis'
```
